prompt.project_info: Create a premium at-home lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman reclining naturally on a modern couch in late-afternoon window light.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with shoulder-length loose natural waves, fair skin, natural texture, and a relaxed candid expression. She wears a deep crimson short spaghetti-strap satin or silk-blend dress with natural sheen, stitched hem, and realistic drape, reclining semi-lying on a modern sofa with one leg slightly bent and looking toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium-wide slightly-above-eye-level handheld frame with the full couch visible and subject placed diagonally. Include neutral beige walls, soft curtains, indoor plants, light wood floor, throw pillow, coffee table, and nearby smartphone as natural home props.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft imperfect late-afternoon window daylight around 4800K with gentle shadows and warm background lamps, clean neutral grade, rich red dress, soft highlight roll-off, and relaxed intimate-but-casual mood.
prompt.technical_specs: iPhone-style 26mm equivalent, f/1.8, shallow realistic background blur, no motion blur, natural high detail, minimal sensor noise, realistic satin and skin texture, subtle grain.
